newsitem.title: CANADA: Bema Gold bounces back in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: Bema Gold bounces back in heavy trading.

text.p: Shares in Bema Gold Corp were up in heavy trading on Wednesday after a downturn on Tuesday.
More than 1.6 million shares traded hands by midday trading, pushing the stock up C$0.40 to C$10.25.
The stock has traded heavily in past week as investors shuffle their positions and speculate about recent drilling results, said one trader.
The stock slid down from C$12.50 at the end of August and is now bouncing back, the trader said.

Since Bema's partner at its Cerro Casale project in Chile, Vancouver-based Arizona Star Resource Corp, has its annual meeting today, investors may be buying on anticipation of good news, dealers said.
